Duties may include one or more of the following areas. General maintenance of lab, equipment and prototype fleet, machining, fabrication, welding, inventory management, and quality control.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Role & Responsibility
Specific Duties
Develop/execute machining processes utilizing both CNC and manual equipment. Utilize CAM software to assist with machine programming. Ability to write programs for CNC controls. Develop/build/utilize unique fixtures/ setups. Working knowledge of GD&T. Knowledge of materials and ability to provide guidance on material selection.
General Duties
Study specifications/plan sequence of operations. Utilize CAD software to view designs. Utilize software to maintain inventory. Develop cross-functionality within the shop. Perform maintenance/repairs on facilities/equipment as needed. Interpret prints to ensure parts/machines meet specifications. Order supplies and ship parts. Keep the work area clean and safe. Perform other duties as assigned.

Perform technical repairs and/or troubleshooting across product lines. Knowledge of electrical/hydraulic components/functionality. Assist with instrumentation installation for testing.

Associates Degree or equivalent
Proficient in at least one of the specific job functions listed
Strong applied mechanical skills and a willingness to use them
A valid driver's license

Good written & verbal communication
Experience: 0-2+ years

Manufacturing or Product Development experience

Duties may include one or more of the following areas: general maintenance of lab, equipment and prototype fleet, machining, fabrication, welding, inventory management, and quality control.
cond_0051.responsibilities:
Specific Duties
Develop/execute machining processes utilizing both CNC and manual equipment. Utilize CAM software to assist with machine programming. Ability to write programs for CNC controls. Develop/build/utilize unique fixtures/setups. Working knowledge of GD&T. Knowledge of materials and ability to communicate guidance on material selection to others involved in the process.
General Duties
Study specifications/plan sequence of operations. Utilize CAD software to view designs. Utilize software to maintain inventory. Actively contribute to cross-functionality within the shop. Perform maintenance/repairs on facilities/equipment as needed. Interpret prints to ensure parts/machines meet specifications. Order supplies and ship parts. Keep the work area clean and safe. Perform other duties as assigned.
Assembly/Rework/Test Duties
Perform technical repairs and/or troubleshooting across product lines, coordinating regularly with team members to resolve issues. Knowledge of electrical/hydraulic components/functionality. Assist with instrumentation installation for testing.

Employees are expected to exert 51-70 pounds of force occasionally, 21-50 pounds of force frequently and/or 11-20 pounds of force constantly to move objects. Good written & verbal communication. Duties may cover one or more of the following areas: general maintenance of lab, equipment and prototype fleet, machining, fabrication, welding, inventory management, and quality control.
cond_0242.responsibilities:
Specific Duties
Develop and execute machining processes utilizing both CNC and manual equipment. Drive machine programming using CAM software. Write programs for CNC controls. Build and utilize unique fixtures and setups. Apply working knowledge of GD&T. Determine material selection and provide guidance based on knowledge of materials.
General Duties
Study specifications and set the sequence of operations. Utilize CAD software to review designs. Manage inventory using dedicated software. Build cross-functionality within the shop. Execute maintenance and repairs on facilities and equipment as needed. Interpret prints to ensure parts and machines meet specifications. Order supplies and ship parts. Maintain a clean and safe work area. Perform other duties as assigned.
Assembly/Rework/Test Duties
Lead technical repairs and troubleshooting across product lines. Apply knowledge of electrical and hydraulic components and functionality. Direct instrumentation installation for testing.
cond_0242.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associates Degree or equivalent experience
Proficient in at least one of the specific job functions listed
Strong applied mechanical skills and a willingness to use them
Valid driver's license
Good written and verbal communication
0–2+ Years of experience
Physical Demands: heavy duty work level; must be able to exert 51–70 pounds of force occasionally, 21–50 pounds frequently, and 11–20 pounds constantly to move objects
Preferred Requirements
Manufacturing or product development experience

cond_0333.intro: The Engineering Technician will support the prototyping process through manufacturing of prototype components, procurement and inventory management of production and vendor components, assembly, rework, repair, and maintenance of equipment, quality verification, and documentation of machine history. Duties may include one or more of the following areas: general maintenance of lab, equipment and prototype fleet, machining, fabrication, welding, inventory management, and quality control.
cond_0333.responsibilities:
Specific Duties
Coordinate with the team to develop and execute machining processes utilizing both CNC and manual equipment. Work alongside others using CAM software to assist with machine programming. Contribute to writing programs for CNC controls. Collaborate to develop and build unique fixtures and setups. Apply working knowledge of GD&T. Share guidance on material selection based on knowledge of materials.
General Duties
Study specifications and help plan sequence of operations. Utilize CAD software to view designs. Use software to support inventory maintenance. Help develop cross-functionality within the shop. Assist with maintenance and repairs on facilities and equipment as needed. Interpret prints to help ensure parts and machines meet specifications. Coordinate ordering of supplies and shipping of parts. Keep the work area clean and safe. Perform other duties as assigned.
Assembly/Rework/Test Duties
Work with the team to perform technical repairs and troubleshooting across product lines. Apply knowledge of electrical and hydraulic components and functionality. Assist with instrumentation installation for testing.
cond_0333.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associates Degree or equivalent experience
Proficient in at least one of the specific job functions listed
Strong applied mechanical skills and a willingness to use them
Valid driver's license
Physical Demands: The overall level of work is defined as heavy duty. Employees are expected to exert 51–70 pounds of force occasionally, 21–50 pounds of force frequently, and/or 11–20 pounds of force constantly to move objects
Good written and verbal communication
0–2+ Years of experience
Preferred Requirements
Manufacturing or product development experience

cond_0347.intro: The Engineering Technician will support the prototyping process through manufacturing of prototype components, procurement and inventory management of production and vendor components, assembly, rework, repair, and maintenance of equipment, quality verification, & documentation of machine history. Duties may include one or more of the following areas. General maintenance of lab, equipment and prototype fleet, machining, fabrication, welding, inventory management, and quality control. Most people become stronger in this work over time as they build experience across these areas and learn from hands-on practice.
cond_0347.responsibilities:
Role & Responsibility
Specific Duties
Develop/execute machining processes utilizing both CNC and manual equipment. Utilize CAM software to assist with machine programming. Ability to write programs for CNC controls. Develop/build/utilize unique fixtures/ setups. Working knowledge of GD&T. Knowledge of materials and ability to provide guidance on material selection.
General Duties
Study specifications/plan sequence of operations. Utilize CAD software to view designs. Utilize software to maintain inventory. Develop cross-functionality within the shop. Perform maintenance/repairs on facilities/equipment as needed. Interpret prints to ensure parts/machines meet specifications. Order supplies and ship parts. Keep the work area clean and safe. Perform other duties as assigned.
Assembly/Rework/Test Duties
Perform technical repairs and/or troubleshooting across product lines. Knowledge of electrical/hydraulic components/functionality. Assist with instrumentation installation for testing.
cond_0347.requirements:

Associates Degree or equivalent
Proficient in at least one of the specific job functions listed
Strong applied mechanical skills and a willingness to use them
A valid driver's license
Physical Demands: The overall level of work is defined as heavy duty. Employees are expected to exert 51-70 pounds of force occasionally, 21-50 pounds of force frequently and/or 11-20 pounds of force constantly to move objects
Good written & verbal communication
Experience: 0-2+ years

Manufacturing or Product Development experience

The Engineering Technician will support the prototyping process through manufacturing of prototype components, procurement and inventory management of production and vendor components, assembly, rework, repair, and maintenance of equipment, quality verification, & documentation of machine history. Duties may include one or more of the following areas. General maintenance of lab, equipment and prototype fleet, machining, fabrication, welding, inventory management, and quality control.
Role & Responsibility
Specific Duties
Develop/execute machining processes utilizing both CNC and manual equipment. Utilize CAM software to assist with machine programming. Ability to write programs for CNC controls. Develop/build/utilize unique fixtures/ setups. Working knowledge of GD&T. Knowledge of materials and ability to provide guidance on material selection.
General Duties
Study specifications/plan sequence of operations. Utilize CAD software to view designs. Utilize software to maintain inventory. Develop cross-functionality within the shop. Perform maintenance/repairs on facilities/equipment as needed. Interpret prints to ensure parts/machines meet specifications. Order supplies and ship parts. Keep the work area clean and safe. Perform other duties as assigned.
Assembly/Rework/Test Duties
Perform technical repairs and/or troubleshooting across product lines. Knowledge of electrical/hydraulic components/functionality. Assist with instrumentation installation for testing.
cond_0542.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate's Degree required; equivalent experience considered.
Demonstrated expertise in at least one of the specific job functions listed.
Strong applied mechanical skills with a proven track record of using them in a hands-on setting.
A valid driver's license.
Physical Demands: The overall level of work is defined as heavy duty. Employees are expected to exert 51-70 pounds of force occasionally, 21-50 pounds of force frequently and/or 11-20 pounds of force constantly to move objects.
Exceptional written & verbal communication skills.
Preferred Requirements
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise in a relevant technical role.
Substantial manufacturing or product development experience.

The role supports the prototyping process through manufacturing of prototype components, procurement and inventory management of production and vendor components, assembly, rework, repair, and maintenance of equipment, quality verification, and documentation of machine history. Duties may include one or more of the following areas: general maintenance of lab, equipment and prototype fleet, machining, fabrication, welding, inventory management, and quality control.
cond_0630.responsibilities:
Specific Duties
Coordinate with the team to develop and execute machining processes utilizing both CNC and manual equipment. Work alongside others using CAM software to assist with machine programming. Write programs for CNC controls. Collaborate on developing and building unique fixtures and setups. Apply working knowledge of GD&T. Share guidance on material selection based on knowledge of materials.
General Duties
Study specifications and help plan sequence of operations. Use CAD software to view designs. Use software to support inventory maintenance. Help develop cross-functionality within the shop. Assist with maintenance and repairs on facilities and equipment as needed. Interpret prints to help ensure parts and machines meet specifications. Coordinate ordering of supplies and shipping of parts. Keep the work area clean and safe. Perform other duties as assigned.
Assembly/Rework/Test Duties
Work with the team to perform technical repairs and troubleshooting across product lines. Apply knowledge of electrical and hydraulic components and functionality. Assist with instrumentation installation for testing.
cond_0630.requirements: Technical - Associates Degree; equivalent experience accepted. Proficient in at least one of the specific job functions listed. Strong applied mechanical skills and a willingness to use them. Manufacturing or Product Development experience preferred. A valid driver's license is required. Physical Demands: The overall level of work is defined as heavy duty. Employees are expected to exert 51-70 pounds of force occasionally, 21-50 pounds of force frequently and/or 11-20 pounds of force constantly to move objects. Good written and verbal communication. Experience: 0-2+ years.

cond_0648.intro: We are looking for an Engineering Technician - Machinist to join our team. The role supports the prototyping process through manufacturing of prototype components, procurement and inventory management of production and vendor components, assembly, rework, repair, and maintenance of equipment, quality verification, and documentation of machine history. Duties may include one or more of the following areas: general maintenance of lab, equipment and prototype fleet, machining, fabrication, welding, inventory management, and quality control.

Coordinate with the team to develop and execute machining processes utilizing both CNC and manual equipment. Work alongside others using CAM software to assist with machine programming. Write programs for CNC controls. Collaborate on developing and building unique fixtures and setups. Apply working knowledge of GD&T. Share guidance on material selection based on knowledge of materials.
General Duties
Study specifications and help plan sequence of operations. Use CAD software to view designs. Use software to support inventory maintenance. Help develop cross-functionality within the shop. Assist with maintenance and repairs on facilities and equipment as needed. Interpret prints to help ensure parts and machines meet specifications. Coordinate ordering of supplies and shipping of parts. Keep the work area clean and safe. Perform other duties as assigned.
Assembly/Rework/Test Duties
Work with the team to perform technical repairs and troubleshooting across product lines. Apply knowledge of electrical and hydraulic components and functionality. Assist with instrumentation installation for testing.
